turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting coolant system diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the initial coolant checks. Check the coolant level against the tank minimum and maximum marks, assess the colour and odour for contamination, and check the refractometer reading against the specified concentration range.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the coolant level against the tank minimum and maximum marks. 2. Assess coolant colour and odour for signs of contamination. 3. Check refractometer reading against the specified concentration range.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Initial checks complete. Coolant level is within range, and I've assessed the colour and odour.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Check the coolant level against the tank minimum and maximum marks. 2. Assess coolant colour and odour for signs of contamination. 3. Check refractometer reading against the specified concentration range.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Severe contamination: tramp oil, biological growth or discolouration?

ground_truth.node_text: Severe contamination: tramp oil, biological growth or discolouration?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No severe contamination detected. The coolant looks clean with no tramp oil or biological growth visible.

ground_truth.node_text: Severe contamination: tramp oil, biological growth or discolouration?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Concentration within specified Brix range?

ground_truth.node_text: Concentration within specified Brix range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The concentration is outside the specified range. Reading is lower than target.

ground_truth.node_text: Concentration within specified Brix range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Top up with concentrate or deionised water to correct the concentration to the target range.

ground_truth.node_text: Top up with concentrate or deionised water to correct concentration

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've added concentrate to bring the concentration up. Top-up complete.

ground_truth.node_text: Top up with concentrate or deionised water to correct concentration

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify concentration after top up.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify concentration after top up

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The concentration is still out of range after the initial top-up.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify concentration after top up

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform secondary coolant correction. Drain 20% of the sump volume using the sump pump and discard the drained coolant. Refill with clean water to the previous level, then add the calculated volume of coolant concentrate to reach target concentration. Run the circulation pump for 5 minutes to mix thoroughly.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary coolant correction: drain 20% of the sump volume using the sump pump and discard the drained coolant. Refill the sump with clean water to the previous level, then add the calculated volume of coolant concentrate to reach the target concentration. Run the circulation pump for 5 minutes to mix thoroughly before returning to the refractometer concentration measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Secondary correction complete. I've drained 20%, refilled with water and concentrate, and run the pump for 5 minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary coolant correction: drain 20% of the sump volume using the sump pump and discard the drained coolant. Refill the sump with clean water to the previous level, then add the calculated volume of coolant concentrate to reach the target concentration. Run the circulation pump for 5 minutes to mix thoroughly before returning to the refractometer concentration measurement step.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify concentration after top up.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify concentration after top up

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Concentration is now within the specified range. Reading looks good.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify concentration after top up

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: pH within acceptable range?

ground_truth.node_text: pH within acceptable range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, pH is within the acceptable range. Reading is at 9.0.

ground_truth.node_text: pH within acceptable range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Coolant flow rate within specified range?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant flow rate within specified range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Flow rate is below the specified minimum. The meter shows reduced flow.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant flow rate within specified range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Replace the coolant filter element and clean the strainer basket.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace coolant filter element and clean strainer basket

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Filter element replaced and strainer basket cleaned. There was significant debris in the basket.

ground_truth.node_text: Replace coolant filter element and clean strainer basket

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify flow rate after filter replacement.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify flow rate after filter replacement

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Flow rate is now back to normal. Reading is within the specified range.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify flow rate after filter replacement

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Coolant return temperature within operating range?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within operating range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Temperature is within the operating range. Reading is 32 degrees Celsius.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant return temperature within operating range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: All coolant nozzles unobstructed and correctly directed?

ground_truth.node_text: All coolant nozzles unobstructed and correctly directed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All nozzles are clear and properly directed. No blockages detected.

ground_truth.node_text: All coolant nozzles unobstructed and correctly directed?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Coolant recovery from chip conveyor operating correctly?

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant recovery from chip conveyor operating correctly?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: There's no visible flow back to the sump from the chip conveyor. Recovery is not operating correctly.

ground_truth.node_text: Coolant recovery from chip conveyor operating correctly?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Clear the chip conveyor return tray and check the drain ports.

ground_truth.node_text: Clear chip conveyor return tray and check drain ports

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Return tray cleared and drain ports checked. Removed accumulated chips.

ground_truth.node_text: Clear chip conveyor return tray and check drain ports

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the sediment depth at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. Record the maximum reading and compare against the maximum permitted depth.

ground_truth.node_text: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. Record the maximum reading and compare against the maximum permitted sediment depth in the sump cleaning schedule. Sediment exceeding 25 millimetres requires immediate sump pump out and cleaning.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Sediment measurements taken at all three points. Maximum reading recorded.

ground_truth.node_text: Use a clean dipstick or graduated probe to measure the depth of settled sediment at three points in the sump: near the pump inlet, at the centre, and at the far end from the pump. Record the maximum reading and compare against the maximum permitted sediment depth in the sump cleaning schedule. Sediment exceeding 25 millimetres requires immediate sump pump out and cleaning.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Sump sediment depth below 20 mm?

ground_truth.node_text: Sump sediment depth below 20 mm?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Sediment depth exceeds 20 millimetres. Maximum reading is 28 millimetres.

ground_truth.node_text: Sump sediment depth below 20 mm?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Schedule a sump clean, drain, scrub and refill.

ground_truth.node_text: Schedule sump clean, drain, scrub and refill

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Sump cleaning scheduled for the next maintenance window.

ground_truth.node_text: Schedule sump clean, drain, scrub and refill

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform a system function test. Run a machine cycle and verify coolant delivery.

ground_truth.node_text: System function test, run machine cycle, verify coolant delivery

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Function test complete. Machine cycle ran successfully and coolant delivery verified.

ground_truth.node_text: System function test, run machine cycle, verify coolant delivery

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log the coolant data, refractometer reading, and update the service record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log coolant data, refractometer reading and update service record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All data logged and service record updated.

ground_truth.node_text: Log coolant data, refractometer reading and update service record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. All coolant system checks have been successfully completed and documented.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, procedure complete.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
